description: Defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_Nmtokens which validates and processes NMTOKENS attribute type content in HTML purification, including methods for validation, splitting tokens, and filtering.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_Nmtokens
classes.description: A class for validating and handling NMTOKENS attribute values for HTML purification.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input string as an NMTOKENS attribute value, splits the string into tokens, filters tokens, and returns the sanitized string or false if invalid.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a space-separated list of tokens into individual tokens using a regular expression pattern.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Processes tokens for filtering; currently returns tokens unaltered but designed for customization.
